Shareable HTML report of an assessment

Source: R/reportSeny.R
reportSeny.Rd

Renders an assessAll() result into one self-contained HTML file: a summary of the calls and the reasons behind them, a reminder that every comparison run should be reported, the traffic-light matrices, a sortable and searchable table of every comparison, the design and variance plots, the composition flags, a card per comparison (plotComparison()), and the thresholds used with their sources.

Usage

reportSeny(
  res,
  file = "seny_report.html",
  title = "seny report",
  maxCards = 100,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

res

The result of assessAll().

file

Path of the HTML file to write. Default "seny_report.html".

title

Report title.

maxCards

Maximum number of comparison cards. Default 100.

open

Open the report in a browser when done. Default interactive().

Value

The path of the report, invisibly.

Details

Cards go to flagged comparisons first (Invalid, Caution, Underpowered, then Adequate; by expected recall within each), up to maxCards; the table always lists every comparison. The report is an R Markdown template: for an editable copy use rmarkdown::draft("my_report.Rmd", template = "seny_report", package = "seny") and set its res_path parameter to a saved assessAll() result.

Needs the rmarkdown and DT packages and pandoc (bundled with RStudio; elsewhere install it, e.g. from conda-forge).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE) && rmarkdown::pandoc_available() &&
    requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
    sce <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "example_sce.rds", package = "seny"))
    res <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",
                     annotations = "cell_type", targetLFC = 1, thetaReps = 0)
    out <- reportSeny(res, file = tempfile(fileext = ".html"), open = FALSE)
    file.exists(out)
}
